title: Water-Cooler Podcasts and Million-Dollar Dreams
description: Steven tells the story of his podcasts, pitches a co-hosted English-teaching show to a colleague, and recounts a Chinese lesson where his teacher talked about why so many people dislike their jobs. He also asks an AI whether an English teacher in China can ever earn a million, and closes with a Remembrance Day reading of "In Flanders Fields."

sentences.zh: 内容速览
sentences.en: Episode Overview

sentences.zh: 今天这期节目，史蒂文聊的是做播客：他自己的，同事们的，还有他一直想重新开张的英语教学播客。
sentences.en: In today's episode, Steven talks about podcasting: his own podcast, his colleagues' podcasts, and the English-teaching podcast he has always wanted to restart.

sentences.zh: 他讲了上一节中文课，和老师聊到了人人爱谈的话题：“你喜欢你的工作吗？”
sentences.en: He talks about his last Chinese lesson, where he and his teacher discussed a topic everyone loves to bring up: "Do you like your job?"

sentences.zh: 接着，他问了 AI 助手 Muse：英语老师能不能赚到一百万？
sentences.en: Next, he asked his AI assistant Muse: can an English teacher earn a million?

sentences.zh: 答案是：“不能，差得远呢。”
sentences.en: The answer: "No, not even close."

sentences.zh: 最后正值加拿大的国殇纪念日，他照例朗读了诗歌《在佛兰德斯战场》。
sentences.en: Finally, since it's Remembrance Day in Canada, he reads the poem "In Flanders Fields" as he does every year.

sentences.zh: 播出平台又多了一个
sentences.en: One more broadcast platform

sentences.zh: 今天史蒂文试了个新花样：节目现在还同步上线 Substack。
sentences.en: Today Steven tried something new: the show now also goes live on Substack at the same time.

sentences.zh: 面前的屏幕一大堆，他的脸也到处都是。
sentences.en: There's a whole pile of screens in front of him, and his face is everywhere.

sentences.zh: 巧的是，今天办公室来了一位同事，她做着好几档播客，其中一档专门聊加拿大青少年剧《Degrassi》。
sentences.en: As it happens, a coworker came into the office today. She hosts several podcasts, and one of them is all about the Canadian teen drama Degrassi.

sentences.zh: 她和朋友每周看一集再聊一集。
sentences.en: Every week she and a friend watch an episode and then talk about it.

sentences.zh: 史蒂文很喜欢这个点子：你完全可以看着电视剧做播客。
sentences.en: Steven loves this idea: you can totally make a podcast while watching a TV show.

sentences.zh: 史蒂文的播客是怎么开始的
sentences.en: How Steven's podcast got started

sentences.zh: 同事问他的播客讲什么，他把来龙去脉讲了一遍：
sentences.en: When a coworker asked what his podcast was about, he told the whole story from start to finish:

sentences.zh: 2020年，疫情期间：前十期是他每周一个人讲一小时。
sentences.en: 2020, during the pandemic: for the first ten episodes, he talked alone for an hour each week.

sentences.zh: 从第十一期起，他开始采访以前的同事、北京的熟人和各地的外籍人士。
sentences.en: Starting with episode eleven, he began interviewing former coworkers, people he knew in Beijing, and expats from all over.

sentences.zh: 这比看上去累多了，至今还有三期没发布，因为录开场白和结束语实在太磨人。
sentences.en: This was much more tiring than it looks. Three episodes still haven't been released, because recording the intros and outros is such a grind.

sentences.zh: 2021年至今：就是现在这档节目，主要面向中年男性，因为他自己就是。
sentences.en: 2021 to now: this is the current show, aimed mainly at middle-aged men, because he is one himself.

sentences.zh: 内容有保健品、健身、在中国的生活，最近还有 AI 和工作自动化。
sentences.en: Topics include supplements, fitness, and life in China, and lately AI and work automation too.

sentences.zh: 用他的话说：“连机器人都帮不上忙，那我还能靠谁？”
sentences.en: In his words: "If even robots can't help, who else can I count on?"

sentences.zh: 英语播客，找个搭档？
sentences.en: An English podcast — with a partner?

sentences.zh: 他提议和同事合作做英语教学播客。
sentences.en: He suggested teaming up with a colleague on a podcast about teaching English.

sentences.zh: 她的反应妙极了：“英语播客？听着像工作。”
sentences.en: Her reaction was priceless: "An English podcast? Sounds like work."

sentences.zh: 史蒂文心想：可不是嘛，也许这就是他总做不下去的原因。
sentences.en: Steven thought: exactly — maybe that's why he could never keep it going.

sentences.zh: 不过，两位老师一起做，比他一个人强。
sentences.en: Still, two teachers doing it together beats him doing it alone.

sentences.zh: 他的想法是：
sentences.en: His idea was:

sentences.zh: 备课变成播客笔记。
sentences.en: Lesson prep becomes podcast notes.

sentences.zh: 同样的内容本来就要给三个班讲，播客只是第四个班。
sentences.en: He already has to teach the same material to three classes; the podcast is just a fourth class.

sentences.zh: 集中录制。
sentences.en: Batch recording.

sentences.zh: 挑一个周末，录完一学期的内容，每期专注讲一个二十五分钟的话题，不跑题，这可是这档节目的老毛病。
sentences.en: Pick one weekend and record a whole semester's worth of episodes, each focused on a single 25-minute topic with no wandering off-topic — the show's chronic problem.

sentences.zh: 实用话题。
sentences.en: Practical topics.

sentences.zh: 比如各自怎么在课堂上用 AI：别拿它当问答机，用它来整理数据、文件夹和文字稿。
sentences.en: For example, how each of them uses AI in class: not as a Q&A machine, but to organize data, folders and transcripts.

sentences.zh: 播客的“茶水间理论”
sentences.en: The "Break Room Theory" of Podcasting

sentences.zh: 觉得没什么可聊？
sentences.en: Think you have nothing to talk about?

sentences.zh: 茶水间的对话有三种：客套的“最近怎么样”，碰到老板时的尴尬寒暄，还有和投缘同事的交心长谈。
sentences.en: There are three kinds of break room conversations: the polite "how's it going," the awkward small talk when you run into the boss, and the heart-to-heart with a coworker you really click with.

sentences.zh: 第三种就是你的播客。
sentences.en: The third kind is your podcast.

sentences.zh: “你的细分领域就是你自己。”
sentences.en: "Your niche is you."

sentences.zh: 但别指望靠它赚钱。
sentences.en: But don't count on making money from it.

sentences.zh: 内容又好又有趣，照样可能一分钱不赚；为了赚钱去做事，说不定还会毁掉你的兴趣。
sentences.en: Content can be good and fun and still not earn a single cent; and doing it for the money might even ruin your interest in it.

sentences.zh: 所以他才爱这档节目：没赞助，没广告，就是一天结束时讲上四十五分钟。
sentences.en: That's why he loves this show: no sponsors, no ads, just forty-five minutes of talking at the end of the day.

sentences.zh: （顺便为昨天道歉：他忘了点发布。
sentences.en: (By the way, he apologizes for yesterday: he forgot to hit publish.

sentences.zh: 有听众留言：“史蒂夫，节目呢？我要我的每日一剂！”
sentences.en: A listener left a comment: "Steve, where's the episode? I want my daily dose!"

sentences.zh: “你喜欢你的工作吗？”
sentences.en: "Do you like your job?"

sentences.zh: 昨晚，史蒂文上了最后一节中文课。
sentences.en: Last night, Steven had his last Chinese lesson.

sentences.zh: 老师在 italki 上教课当副业，平台抽走 21% 的课时费。
sentences.en: His teacher teaches on italki as a side job, and the platform takes 21% of the lesson fee.

sentences.zh: 他直接问：为什么中国人不喜欢自己的工作？
sentences.en: He asked her straight out: why don't Chinese people like their jobs?

sentences.zh: 她想出国吗？
sentences.en: Does she want to go abroad?

sentences.zh: 当然，加拿大、韩国、日本、欧洲、澳大利亚都行。
sentences.en: Of course: Canada, South Korea, Japan, Europe, Australia, any of them would do.

sentences.zh: 她想做点动手的活，比如星巴克或酒店，只是不想再坐办公室。
sentences.en: She wants to do some hands-on work, like at Starbucks or a hotel. She just doesn't want to sit in an office anymore.

sentences.zh: 史蒂文很理解，不过也提醒：干过才发现办公室也没那么糟。
sentences.en: Steven understood completely, but he also warned her that you only realize an office isn't so bad after you've done that kind of work.

sentences.zh: 他曾持打工度假签证在澳大利亚待了两年。
sentences.en: He once spent two years in Australia on a working holiday visa.

sentences.zh: 老板、996 与外国领导
sentences.en: Bosses, 996 and foreign managers

sentences.zh: 老师说，压力来自老板。
sentences.en: The teacher says the pressure comes from the bosses.

sentences.zh: 史蒂文不禁想：这是上头压下来的，还是中层为了在上级面前表现，才“严格”（yángé）起来的？
sentences.en: Steven can't help wondering: is this pressure coming down from the top, or are middle managers getting "strict" (yángé) to look good in front of their superiors?

sentences.zh: 有些人宁愿给外国领导干活，因为他们更宽松。
sentences.en: Some people would rather work for foreign managers, because they're more relaxed.

sentences.zh: 996（早九晚九，每周六天）虽然常见，可走过任何一间办公室，你都会看到九十分钟的午休加小睡，还有一堆人在刷手机。
sentences.en: 996 (9 a.m. to 9 p.m., six days a week) may be common, but walk through any office and you'll see ninety-minute lunch breaks with naps, plus loads of people scrolling on their phones.

sentences.zh: 是因为讨厌工作，还是因为没多少事可干？
sentences.en: Is it because they hate work, or because there isn't much to do?

sentences.zh: 他也说不准。
sentences.en: He can't say for sure either.

sentences.zh: 英语教学的收入天花板
sentences.en: The income ceiling of English teaching

sentences.zh: 老师说，西安两居室月租约 1500 到 2000 元。
sentences.en: A teacher said a two-bedroom apartment in Xi'an rents for about 1,500 to 2,000 yuan a month.

sentences.zh: 但史蒂文查了一下：西安大学少，课时多，工资也没高多少。
sentences.en: But Steven looked into it: Xi'an has few universities, the teaching hours are longer, and the pay isn't much higher.

sentences.zh: 结论：史蒂文，还是留在北京吧。
sentences.en: Conclusion: Steven, you'd better stay in Beijing.

sentences.zh: 接着，他向 Meta 的新 AI Muse 提了几个问题：
sentences.en: Next, he asked Meta's new AI, Muse, a few questions:

sentences.zh: 搬去西安？
sentences.en: Move to Xi'an?

sentences.zh: 没太大意义。
sentences.en: Not much point.

sentences.zh: “你不会为了钱搬家。”
sentences.en: "You wouldn't move for the money."

sentences.zh: 我到顶了吗？
sentences.en: Have I hit the ceiling?

sentences.zh: 差不多。
sentences.en: Pretty much.

sentences.zh: 月薪三万五（约七千加元）基本是上限，通常还包住宿。
sentences.en: A monthly salary of 35,000 yuan (about 7,000 Canadian dollars) is basically the cap, and housing is usually included.

sentences.zh: 回去读硕士？
sentences.en: Go back and get a master's degree?

sentences.zh: 意义不大，也就多几千元。
sentences.en: Not much point; it's only a few thousand yuan more.

sentences.zh: 到中国退休年龄前赚到一百万？
sentences.en: Earn a million before China's retirement age?

sentences.zh: “不能，差得远呢。”
sentences.en: "No, not even close."

sentences.zh: 哎哟！
sentences.en: Ouch!

sentences.zh: 史蒂文的看法：英语教学对年轻人和退休人士都是好工作。
sentences.en: Steven's view: English teaching is a good job for both young people and retirees.

sentences.zh: 那他为什么还在做？
sentences.en: So why is he still doing it?

sentences.zh: “因为别的我都不行。”
sentences.en: "Because I'm no good at anything else."

sentences.zh: 不过他很感激自己的加拿大护照，也感激二十年来能在世界各地生活和工作。
sentences.en: Still, he's grateful for his Canadian passport, and grateful to have been able to live and work all over the world for twenty years.

sentences.zh: 双十一与国殇纪念日
sentences.en: Singles' Day and Remembrance Day

sentences.zh: 今天是中国的双十一。
sentences.en: Today is Singles' Day in China.

sentences.zh: 在加拿大，今天是国殇纪念日。
sentences.en: In Canada, today is Remembrance Day.

sentences.zh: 和往年一样，他以约翰·麦克雷中校的《在佛兰德斯战场》结束节目。
sentences.en: As in past years, he ends the show with Lieutenant Colonel John McCrae's "In Flanders Fields."

sentences.zh: lest we forget，永不忘记。
sentences.en: Lest we forget — never forget.

sentences.zh: 今日总结
sentences.en: Today's Summary

sentences.zh: 聊你熟悉的事，就像在茶水间和投缘的同事聊天那样。
sentences.en: Talk about things you know well, just like chatting with a coworker you get along with in the break room.

sentences.zh: 只是别指望靠播客或教英语一夜变成百万富翁。
sentences.en: Just don't expect to become a millionaire overnight from podcasting or teaching English.

vocab.en: ceiling (a limit on pay or growth)
